next.reason: 1985: 'IF condition-1 THEN NEXT SENTENCE ... ELSE {statement-2} … [END-IF] | END-IF'; 2023: 'Format 1 (delimited): IF condition-1 THEN statement-1 [ ELSE statement-2 ] END-IF; Format 2 (historic) ... NEXT SENTENCE (no END-IF)'. 1985 lets THEN NEXT SENTENCE be ended by END-IF. In 2023 END-IF exists only in Format 1, which has no NEXT SENTENCE, so IF c NEXT SENTENCE ... END-IF is now refused.
